Package com.j3d.engine

Class Logger

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.Logger
public class Logger extends Object
The Logger class provides a simple logging utility. It supports logging messages to both the console and the DebugPanel.logTextArea This class includes methods for standard logging, error logging, and clearing the log area.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

      public void println(String message)
      Logs a standard message. The message is prefixed with [J3D] and printed to the console. If a JTextArea is provided, the message is also appended to it.
